where.if: and (t.name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.city ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

if.test: status != null and status != '' and status != 'ALL'

where.if: and t.trial_end_at between current_date and current_date + interval '7 days'

mapper.select:
select t.id, t.name, t.city, t.trial_start_at as trialStartAt, t.trial_end_at as trialEndAt, t.status, coalesce(tenant_wechat.wechat_id, default_wechat.wechat_id, t.support_wechat_id) as supportWechatId, coalesce(s.issued_cards, 0) as issuedCards, coalesce(s.deductions, 0) as deductions, coalesce(s.warning_count, 0) as warningCount, coalesce(s.monthly_sales_yuan, 0) as monthlySalesYuan from tenant t left join tenant_business_snapshot s on s.tenant_id = t.id left join support_wechat tenant_wechat on tenant_wechat.tenant_id = t.id left join support_wechat default_wechat on default_wechat.tenant_id is null
order by t.trial_end_at asc, t.id asc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}

select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where status = 'TRIALING') as trialing, count(*) filter (where status = 'EXPIRING') as expiring, count(*) filter (where status = 'FROZEN') as frozen, count(*) filter (where status = 'EXTENDED') as extended from tenant

select t.id, t.name, t.city, t.status, t.trial_start_at, t.trial_end_at, t.frozen_reason, coalesce(tenant_wechat.wechat_id, default_wechat.wechat_id, t.support_wechat_id) as support_wechat_id, st.name as store_name, st.business_categories, st.service_tags, st.address, st.contact_phone, st.business_hours, coalesce(s.issued_cards, 0) as issued_cards, coalesce(s.checkins, 0) as checkins, coalesce(s.deductions, 0) as deductions, coalesce(s.warning_count, 0) as warning_count, coalesce(s.low_balance_count, 0) as low_balance_count, coalesce(s.expiring_count, 0) as expiring_count, coalesce(s.monthly_sales_yuan, 0) as monthly_sales_yuan, s.last_activity_at from tenant t left join store st on st.tenant_id = t.id left join tenant_business_snapshot s on s.tenant_id = t.id left join support_wechat tenant_wechat on tenant_wechat.tenant_id = t.id left join support_wechat default_wechat on default_wechat.tenant_id is null where t.id = #{tenantId}

select id, name, city, status, trial_start_at as trialStartAt, trial_end_at as trialEndAt, frozen_reason as frozenReason, support_wechat_id as supportWechatId, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from tenant where status != 'FROZEN' and trial_end_at < current_date order by trial_end_at asc, id asc
mapper.update: update tenant set status = 'FROZEN', frozen_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{tenantId} and status != 'FROZEN' and trial_end_at < current_date
